verdict.rationale: Stripe documents stablecoin payout capabilities: Global Payouts can send stablecoins to any external crypto wallet, payouts can go to Link users, and Connect platforms can pay connected accounts in USDC while Stripe handles conversion. Bridge also advertises programmatic off-ramp flows and webhooks. However, the evidence does not explicitly show an API call for paying a wallet address or stored recipient, or documented payout status states through on-chain settlement. Connect stablecoin payouts depend on recipients linking a wallet in the Express Dashboard, and a community report says recipients must be individuals or sole proprietors. Missing for 10: explicit API reference for creating stablecoin payouts to a wallet or stored recipient, documented payout status lifecycle to final settlement, and hands-on corroboration of programmatic payouts.
